Chapter 11: Creating a New World — Vision, Action, and Hope.
The world’s changing—sometimes so quickly, it feels like it’s spinning out of control, doesn’t it? Old systems are crumbling, and new possibilities are popping up everywhere. If you ever feel overwhelmed or wonder if what you do really matters, you’re not alone. But here’s something powerful: the conversation with God reminds us that each of us is a creator. The future isn’t set in stone. It’s wide open, just waiting for us to shape it.
Picture this—a group of friends, frustrated by the state of the world, coming together to talk about what’s on their minds. They worry about climate change, inequality, violence... and that uncomfortable feeling that things might be falling apart. But as they talk, something shifts. Their focus moves from what’s wrong to what could be. They start to imagine a world where compassion matters more than competition, where differences aren’t just tolerated but celebrated, and where everyone truly has enough. You can almost feel the energy in the room change—from despair to hope, from resignation to possibility.
What’s the secret? Vision. That’s the first step in creating a new world. Most of us get stuck seeing what’s broken, what’s missing. But what if we dared to imagine something better? What if we held onto a vision of a world that really works for everyone? That’s the invitation: to believe that change is possible, and to keep that vision alive, even when it feels hard.
Think about a young activist, frustrated that progress is so slow. She wonders if her efforts even matter. Then, she remembers a small act of kindness that once changed her life. Suddenly, it clicks. Every action—no matter how small—has the power to ripple out into the world. This conversation with God isn’t asking us to be naive. It’s reminding us that hope is necessary. Hope isn’t just wishful thinking; it’s the fuel that powers real transformation, the light that guides us forward.
Here’s something you might not notice: our beliefs shape our reality. When enough people start to believe that change is possible, the world begins to shift in ways we might never expect. So, why not dream boldly? Why not act courageously? Trust that together, we can write a brand new story for all of humanity.
Creating a new world isn’t about waiting for someone else to take the lead. It’s about you—stepping up in your own unique way, bringing your gifts, your vision, your love to the table. Remember, the conversation with God is a gentle but powerful reminder: the future isn’t something that just happens to us. It’s something we create, together.
